materials.title: Class Door 001
materials.text: At the classroom door, children talk to their teacher. Choose a useful reply for each little talk.

questions.prompt: Teacher: Good morning, Lily. Lily: ____
questions.explanation: B回应早安；A晚安用于睡前，C告别。

questions.prompt: Lily has wet hands. The class towel is beside the door. Lily wants to dry her hands. Lily: ____
options: May I open my lunch box?
questions.explanation: A向教师请求使用眼前毛巾，符合湿手需擦干的具体需要；B开饭盒不能擦手；C借尺不能解决湿手问题。

questions.prompt: Teacher: Please close the door. Lily: ____
questions.explanation: C接受关门指令；A称呼爸爸，B说动物，均不合此交流。

questions.prompt: Teacher: How are you today? Lily: ____
questions.explanation: A回答身体状态并致谢；B物品名称，C地点，不答问候。

questions.prompt: Lily: Goodbye, teacher. Teacher: ____
questions.explanation: B回应告别；A说喜好，C下指令，都不是相应告别。

materials.title: Snack Table 001
materials.text: Sam and Mia are at the snack table. Read each short talk and choose the best reply.

questions.prompt: Mia: Would you like some milk? Sam: ____
questions.explanation: A接受牛奶邀请；B自我介绍，C说颜色，均未回应邀请。

questions.prompt: Sam: Here is your apple. Mia: ____
questions.explanation: B收到苹果后致谢；A说能力，C早晨问候，均不表达感谢。

questions.prompt: Mia: Thank you, Sam. Sam: ____
questions.explanation: C回应感谢；A说杯子，B说年龄，都不合礼貌应答。

questions.prompt: Sam: Can I have a spoon, please? Mia: ____
questions.explanation: A递给勺子；B喜好，C天气，均不回应索取。

questions.prompt: Mia: Do you like bananas? Sam: ____
questions.explanation: B回答是否喜欢；A位置，C名字，均不答一般疑问句。

materials.title: Rainy Play Box 001
materials.text: It is raining. Ben and May play at home. Ben has a toy boat. It is yellow. May has two red cars. The cars are in a small box. Ben puts his boat on the table. They do not play in the garden.

questions.prompt: Ben and May play at home.
questions.explanation: A正确：原文在家玩；B否定与at home相反。

questions.prompt: The toy boat is red.
questions.explanation: B正确：船是yellow；A把汽车的红色用到船上。

questions.prompt: May has two cars.
questions.explanation: A正确：two red cars明确数量；B与two矛盾。

questions.prompt: The boat is in the box.
questions.explanation: B正确：船在桌上，盒内是汽车；A混淆位置。

questions.prompt: Ben and May play in the garden.
questions.explanation: B正确：末句说不在花园玩；A与否定句相反。

materials.title: Lunch Bag Note 001
materials.text: My name is Lucy. This is my lunch bag. It is green. There are two eggs and a sandwich in it. My water bottle is not in the bag. It is on my desk. I eat lunch with Tom. Tom has an orange, but I do not.

questions.prompt: Lucy has a green lunch bag.
questions.explanation: A正确：午餐袋是green；B与颜色信息矛盾。

questions.prompt: There are three eggs in the bag.
questions.explanation: B正确：原文two eggs；A把二误读为三。

questions.prompt: The water bottle is on the desk.
questions.explanation: A正确：水瓶在desk上；B与明确位置不符。

questions.prompt: Lucy eats lunch alone.
questions.explanation: B正确：她与Tom一起吃；A的alone与with Tom相反。

questions.prompt: Tom has an orange.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句说Tom has an orange；B将Lucy没有橙子误套给Tom。

materials.title: Library Chair Note 001
materials.text: Our class has a small book corner. There are six chairs beside the window. On Monday, one chair has a broken leg. Mr Lee puts a red card on it. The card says, "Please do not sit here." After lunch, he takes the chair to the school office. A worker will fix it. The children can use the other five chairs. They leave the space near the door empty so everyone can walk into the corner easily.

questions.prompt: Where are the chairs?
questions.explanation: A原文beside the window；B把维修地点误作椅子原位置；C无校外信息。

questions.prompt: What is wrong with one chair?
questions.explanation: B对应broken leg；A椅上有红卡；C没有尺寸问题。

questions.prompt: What does the red card ask children to do?
questions.explanation: C对应Please do not sit here；A没要求刷漆；B没要求带回家。

questions.prompt: How many chairs can the children use now?
questions.explanation: A其余五把可以用；B包含坏椅；C把坏椅数量当可用数量。

questions.prompt: Why is the space near the door empty?
options: To let people walk in easily.
questions.explanation: B末句说明方便进入；A与卡片无关；C没有放食物计划。

materials.title: Market Leaf Sign 001
materials.text: On Saturday, Nora helps her grandpa at his vegetable stall. Grandpa grows carrots and beans. A green leaf sign stands beside the beans. It says, "Pick this morning." Nora changes it to "Picked this morning" because the beans are already in baskets. A customer asks for two bags of beans. Nora weighs them and puts them in paper bags. At noon, she takes the sign inside because the wind is getting strong.

questions.prompt: Nora helps at the stall on Sunday.
questions.explanation: B正确：时间是Saturday；A把星期六改为星期日。

questions.prompt: The green sign is beside the beans.
questions.explanation: A正确：原文明确标牌在豆旁；B与beside the beans相反。

questions.prompt: Nora changes the sign because the beans are already picked.
questions.explanation: A正确：豆已在篮里，所以改为Picked；B否认原文给出的原因。

questions.prompt: The customer wants two bags of carrots.
questions.explanation: B正确：顾客要两袋beans；A把豆换成胡萝卜。

questions.prompt: Nora takes the sign inside because of the wind.
questions.explanation: A正确：末句说明风变大；B不符合明确原因。

materials.title: School Map Stickers 001
materials.text: The school office gives the new pupils a map. On the map, a blue star shows the library and a green circle shows the garden. The sports hall has no sticker because it is closed for repairs this week. On Tuesday, Amir notices that the library star is on the wrong building. He walks to the office instead of moving it himself. A teacher checks the map, thanks him and prints corrected copies. Pupils who already have a map can exchange it at the office before Friday. There is no charge. The teacher also puts a correct map on the noticeboard near the main gate.

questions.prompt: What does the green circle show?
questions.explanation: B绿圈表示garden；A图书馆用蓝星；C体育馆没贴纸；D大门是公告板位置。

questions.prompt: Why does the sports hall have no sticker?
questions.explanation: C原文关闭维修；A没说校外；B不是新图书馆；D没有名称丢失。

questions.prompt: What does Amir do when he finds the mistake?
questions.explanation: A他走到办公室反映；B并未自行挪贴纸；C没有卖地图；D周二即行动。

questions.prompt: How can pupils get a corrected copy?
options: Ask the sports coach next week.
Print it at home for a fee.
Exchange the old map at the office.
questions.explanation: D周五前在办公室免费换；A购买地点错误；B人物与时间无依据；C收费与no charge相反。

questions.prompt: Where can pupils see a correct map without exchanging a copy?
options: On the noticeboard near the main gate.
questions.explanation: B末句明确公告板在大门附近；A关闭场馆内无此信息；C公交站、D花园墙均未提。

units.title: 修理活动中的物品标签

materials.title: Repair Cafe Labels 001
materials.text:
The community centre held a repair afternoon for children. Families brought small toys, lamps and bags. Volunteers did not promise to repair everything, but they explained what they could safely check. Each item received a paper label with its owner’s first name and a number. The label stayed with the item while it moved between tables.

Ella brought a toy train that stopped on curves. A volunteer found that one wheel was loose. Ella watched him tighten it and then tested the train on a short track. Her brother wanted to remove its label as soon as it moved again. Ella kept it on until the collection desk checked their number. Two other children had brought the same kind of train, so the label still mattered after the repair.

At the end, families could take home a simple care card. It explained how to keep items clean and when to ask an adult for help. The organiser counted repaired items and items that needed a specialist separately. She said that learning the limit of a safe repair was also a useful result.

questions.prompt: Why were labels attached to the items?
options: To make all toys look new.
To identify the owners and items.
To show the price of a repair.
questions.explanation: B标签含主人名和编号用于识别；A不改变外观；C没有价格；D不用于遮损坏。

questions.prompt: What made Ella’s train stop on curves?
questions.explanation: C志愿者找到松动轮子；A灯不是火车问题；B护理卡不影响运行；D标签编号非故障原因。

questions.prompt: Why did Ella keep the label after testing?
options: She wanted to sell the train.
The volunteer could not find a wheel.
The track belonged to her brother.
questions.explanation: A同款火车存在，领取仍需核对；B无出售；C已找到并拧紧轮子；D无轨道归属信息。

questions.prompt: What was the care card for?
questions.explanation: D说明清洁及何时找成人帮助；A车票、B订灯、C选名字均非卡片内容。

questions.prompt: Why did the organiser count specialist cases separately?
options: To pretend every item was repaired.
To recognise that some repairs needed other help.
To prevent families from taking items home.
To replace the paper labels with prices.
questions.explanation: B强调安全维修有界限；A分别记录避免全修好错觉；C没有扣留物品；D未用价签替换。
